reasons: dense: kernel flash_attention_2 not usable here: flash-attn is not installed
NF4 base (QLoRA), by objective speed or a fixed field
frozen layers resident: 27.68 GiB estimated + 1.57 GiB headroom fits the 31.34 GiB budget
LoRA r16 alpha 32 (fp32) on every classified projection role: 134,217,728 parameters
loss chunked 512 tokens at a time (experts4bit-qlora chunked_lm_loss)

ordering, base: bf16 before NF4: the frozen weights stay exact, and NF4's dequantization costs at most ~10% of linear time at 2,048 tokens per micro-batch and ~5% at 4,096 (DQ1: H(2048) = 0.097, H(4096) = 0.050)

ordering, placement: resident before streamed: streamed NF4 layers ran at 1.0023x (PCIe 5.0) and 1.0050x (PCIe 4.0) a resident step at 2,048 tokens per micro-batch (DQ3, DQ5), but cost speed below the break-even of ~0.26 F/B tokens (DQ1: ~1,760 on PCIe 4.0), and hold the frozen weights in pinned host memory
